<!-- pr-reviewer: bae9b7b5a9927e2be97b2a1e0cc6154e2a24c0cd -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding. The local GPU failures also occur on bare upstream main.

What looks good:
- The window keeps its own draft and sync key. The shared rows use that draft during drawing and Apply.
- Apply uses the existing validated, undoable commands. The tests check geometry and catalog edits, undo, draft separation, and layout.
- The before/after screenshot links load. No snapshot PNG changes.
- No new dependency, process change, importer change, fixture change, or recorded program change.

Local results:

Reviewed against the laws in upstream main `b13f790ecacf8baeed0a8d571f3ae3f3cd72dea9`.
Trial merge: `fc288804b64db8fe2132da73823380bfa42663a3`. Its first parent is the PR head above.
U1 (#3900) is already on this main. The remaining diff has 13 files. I read the complete remaining diff.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 18 steps, 2 failed, 0 stalled. The build passed.

| UI suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| lib | 1587 | 7 | 8 |
| boundary | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| boundary_picks | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| catalog_render | 2 | 0 | 1 |
| contour_dxf_sketch | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| feedback | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| fixtures | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| gpu_render | 19 | 0 | 1 |
| machine | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| models | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| operations | 31 | 0 | 0 |
| shell | 20 | 1 | 0 |
| sinker_setup | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| tap_hand | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| theme_example | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| theme_files | 17 | 0 | 0 |
| waterjet_tool | 1 | 0 | 0 |

All four new pinning tests passed:
- `egui_app::tests::tool_library_editor::apply_is_one_change_tool_and_undo_restores`
- `egui_app::tests::tool_library_editor::the_dialog_draft_and_the_properties_draft_do_not_mix`
- `egui_app::tests::tool_library_editor::details_tab_shows_the_catalog_facts`
- `egui_app::tests::page_layout_tool_library::layout_window_tool_editor`

`cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run:
- `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 41 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored. The recorded NC checks passed.
- On bare upstream main, from `crates/ui`: `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast --lib --test shell -- --test-threads=16`. Lib: 1583 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored. Shell: 20 passed, 1 failed. The failed tests and errors match the trial merge.

Pre-existing local failures:
- The six `egui_app::report_tests` tests fail when they create a render state:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

- `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` reports `egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter`.
- `shell::headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero` returns 1 instead of 0 on both trees.

No issue was found that tracks these exact local failures. #3879 tracks the related problem of hidden GPU skips.
The baseline comparison found no failure introduced by this PR. The quick gate itself is not green on this host.

Safety and mutations:
The change adds a UI over existing tool commands. It changes no posting, geometry, collision, gouge, or stock-simulation implementation.
No goldens moved. Safety mutations and heavy lanes were not required and were not run.
No source code was changed for this review. The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
